notes: The verse has more source morphemes than target tokens; the surplus falls on the unrendered `מִלִּין` and on the object marker `אֵת`, which is rule 16's ordinary unrepresented case.
MACULA's gloss on `אֲשִׁיבְךָ` is distributed in reverse across the segments (rule 39); the morphology governs, so the verb takes *will answer* and the suffix *thee*.
